text:
maya: Heads up — need to push a hotfix for model routing causing 503s to prod during the current change window. Can someone with prod-press rights press? ETA ~20m.

alex: Is this inside the approved change window? We have a blackout starting 21:45 UTC.

maya: It's inside the window until 21:30 UTC, so we have a short runway. Impact: dedicated pools intermittently return 503 on long sequences. If we wait it'll cascade to customer timeouts.

chris: What's the image/tag and rollback plan? Prefer pinning to a specific stable if we need to revert quickly.

maya: Image: registry.redwood/inference:service-8a3f2-hotfix. Canary plan: deploy to 2 nodes for 5m smoke, then ramp. Rollback target: service-7f4d1 (previous stable).

jamie: I can press but deploy-bot is rejecting me — MFA/group issue. I get `permission_denied: missing prod-deploy` when running the deploy command.

deploy-bot: @jamie attempted to trigger a deploy but is not a member of group `prod-deployers`. To request JIT access run: `/request-jit --role prod-deploy --expires 30m` or ask an approver to grant temporary membership.

ops-approver: I can approve JIT for Jamie but need the smoke results command output + a brief checklist (db migrations? config flags?).

maya: Smoke checks (stdout):
```
OK  smoke: /health -> 200
OK  model-serving: p95 latency 42ms
FAIL inference-route: 503 on long sequence XID=abc123
```
No DB migrations. Config change: routing table tweak in `routing.yaml` (non-destructive).

ops-approver: Approved for 30m JIT. Granting now. Please follow the approved deploy playbook and document the steps. (approver: ops-approver) :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: JIT granted to @jamie until 1758906121. Manual trigger command:
```
./release/deploy.sh --env=prod --image=registry.redwood/inference:service-8a3f2-hotfix --canary=2
```

jamie: Pressing now. will watch logs and metrics. :eyes:

chris: After deploy, add a release-note entry: short changelog, pinned version, canary window, and who approved. Example: "fix(routing): avoid KV cache path for long sequences — pinned to service-8a3f2-hotfix. Canary 2->10. Approved by ops-approver."

maya: Draft release note added to CHANGELOG: "fix: model routing hotfix (service-8a3f2-hotfix). Impact: restored stability for long sequences. Rollback: service-7f4d1."

jamie: Canary succeeded on 2 nodes, smoke ok, promoting to 10 nodes now. No errors in 3m.

deploy-bot: Deploy completed to 10 nodes. Metrics snapshot: error_rate delta -0.1%, p95 latency +8ms, overall healthy. :tada:

chris: Good. Filing a follow-up to tighten MFA role rotation — we had two people blocked by JIT earlier this month. Recommend a short oncall checklist and a backup approver.

maya: Filing INF-1427: "prod deployer rotation and JIT coverage" — assigning to platform team.

ops-approver: Quick note to close the loop: rollback command if needed:
```
kubectl rollout undo deployment/inference-service --to-revision=3
```
Keep the JIT active until verification complete; revoke early if you see anomalies.

jamie: Keeping JIT active for now, will revoke if everything stays green. Thanks all. :heart:

sre-rotation: Noted — will add a rotation backup and update the runbook with the rollback snippet.

maya: Closing thread once INF-1427 is created and release note merged. Thanks everyone for quick approvals. :smile:
